purpose: Independent preservation and verification of SPETL evidence outside the governed runtime executor's unrestricted write capability.

read_verify_semantics.tamper_detection: bundle hash + complete event hash-chain verification

retention_and_rights.personal_data_default: PROHIBITED_BY_DESIGN; use pseudonymous subject_ref and data minimization metadata

credential_rotation.github_sender: short-lived GitHub OIDC token per workflow run
credential_rotation.vercel_storage: Vercel-managed project-to-Blob binding scoped to the custody project; no storage credential is held by the governed runtime executor.

closure_rule: CDX-BLOCK-EVIDENCE-INDEPENDENCE-001 may close only after an approved independent custody profile has actual observed write/read/verify provenance and the complete allow/deny/policy-unavailable, denied-write, invalid-event, tamper, withheld/loss, different-runtime and forged-authority matrix passes. The Vercel project is the long-lived production target profile but is not required to misrepresent the reference custody profile as unverified when a separate approved profile is actually observed.

reference_profile.trust_separation: producer, custodian and verifier execute as separate workflow runs; custodian/verifier read trusted main code and have no repository write permission
